description: The record of whether each feature uses one agent or several, justified by measured quality, cost and latency, with the limits that keep it in budget.
The same golden tasks run through each candidate architecture, with pass rate, cost per task and latency side by side.
Planner attempts plus synthesis plus the maximum number of workers; it must fit the per-task budget.
What a failed worker means for the run (continue with a listed gap or abort) and the minimum share of successful workers for a usable result.
In-process for your own co-deployed agents, MCP for quick capabilities with schemas, A2A for long-running work by independently deployed agents.
